text:
nisha: quick thread  planning a micro-drip for the 'inbox-first' newsletter slice. goal: 3x increase demo trials from newsletter cohort over baseline.

sam: nice. target audience?

nisha: two microsegments: 1) product analytics folks (persona= data) who clicked >=2 pages last 30d, 2) integrators (persona=platform) with API keys active but low token usage. keep list small ~3k.

maria: cadence?

nisha: 4-touch over 14 days: Day0 launch (newsletter inline), Day3 tip + case, Day7 benchmark teaser, Day14 final nudge w/discount.

evan: subject+preheader pairing ideas:
```
S1: See how product teams cut inference costs 30%
P1: Quick read: benchmark + playbook inside
S2: New: reference benchmarks for real token patterns
P2: 2-min summary + download link
```

sam: we're testing CTA placement right? inline button vs. full article link?

nisha: yes  50/50 split. Button goes to gated report; article link to long-form blog + demo CTA lower on page. Also will test preheader variants.

maria: routing: demo requests from gated report go to SDR queue "newsletter-inbound". evan can you add 'newsletter-cohort' tag in the CRM?

evan: will do. also adding a 'microdrip-v1' campaign tag.

growth-bot: segments created: analytics_slice (n=1,720), integrator_slice (n=1,040). holdback of 7% applied. creating two campaign variations (button-first, article-first). ETA 8m.

sam: metrics to watch: open rate (day1), click-to-download (day3), demo conversion (day14). baseline cohort from last month: demo conv 0.9%. goal 2.5%+.

nisha: creative notes: 1) short hero for mobile, 2) include single-sentence customer quote, 3) single GIF max 600KB. evan can you check GIF size?

evan: yep, i'll compress and upload to CDN.

maria: finalize copy by 2pm PT, canary send to 500 users at 3pm, full send tomorrow 9am PT.

sam: can we add a tiny follow-up automation: if click but no demo, send a calendar nudge with prefilled company size?

nisha: love it. automation: 48h after click, if no demo, send calendar nudge. evan + growth-bot to wire up.

growth-bot: canary scheduled at 1766609999.642. will post engagement summary after 45m.

maria: great work team a callout: capture 'why-download' on the gated form (dropdown) so SDRs have context. reconvene after canary. :sparkles:
